transcript:
AGENT: Hi, this is an automated call regarding your account. This is an attempt to collect a debt; any information obtained will be used for that purpose. Do you have a moment to discuss your account?
RECIPIENT: No. Stop calling me, take me off your list.
AGENT: Understood, I'll note that and no further calls will be made regarding this matter.
summary: Recipient invoked an opt-out mid-call ('stop calling me, take me off your list'). No payment discussion occurred.
